In detail

111.53 in 2025, second highest and consistently near the top of the table for a decade. The figures are the Bucharest Police's own published “coefficient of specific criminality” by sector, 2014-2025. The force does not state what the coefficient is per, so it is used here to compare sectors against each other and against their own past, which is what it supports, and not read as a rate per head. Large socialist-era housing estates west of the centre — Militari, Drumul Taberei, Crângași — with nothing that draws visitors and no reason to be walking them late.
